title: Federated Learning Privacy Protection Method and System Based on Homomorphic Pseudo-random Numbers

pse.problem: Data privacy concerns in federated learning due to the transmission of updated gradient values that may leak sensitive information
pse.solution_function: Homomorphic pseudo-random number-based federated learning privacy protection method for secure key generation, data privacy preservation during model training, and efficient recovery of shared keys
pse.solution_structure: VSS (Verifiable Secret Sharing) scheme used by clients to generate and share secret keys, each client holding a unique secret share; server for collecting and combining secret shares to recover the key
pse.solution_implementation: Clients perform local model training using their own data to produce updated gradient values. Each client applies the homomorphic property of pseudo-random numbers to compute encrypted updates (s i F(s i ,x)). Combined encrypted updates are decrypted by server to obtain final updated gradient values
pse.effect: Improved data privacy protection and reduced risk of sensitive information leakage in federated learning scenarios
